usageNotes: Use this to inspect the full configuration of a specific vzdump backup job before modifying or cloning it — particularly useful for auditing retention policy (prune-backups), compression settings, and which guests are targeted. Requires Sys.Audit privilege at the root path (/). The job ID can be obtained from list_cluster_backup; the response is synchronous and returns the full job definition including the next scheduled run time.

examples.summary: Read a specific cluster backup job definition

tips: The next-run field returns a UNIX timestamp; convert it to a readable date to confirm the schedule is active.
If enabled is absent or true and next-run is missing, the job may lack a valid schedule — check the schedule field.
The mailnotification and mailto fields are deprecated; prefer notification-mode with PVE's notification system.
A job with node set will only execute when vzdump runs on that specific node — cluster-wide jobs omit this field.
